flows:
Navigate to https://www.earthcam.com/ then Use only keyboard input.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Complete the registered journey in order and check each requested outcome.
For keyboard operation, use the declared arrow keys and Escape as needed.
Do not use a substitute destination or control.
If a required control or outcome is inaccessible, report the exact step that failed.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Expand “Menu” with the keyboard and read “Construction Monitoring”.

verdict.root_cause: The privacy dialog did not close when its visible buttons were activated with Enter. It kept keyboard focus in the dialog, so the user could not continue to the requested navigation control.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent used the required keyboard-only method and pressed Enter on the dialog controls, then allowed time for the dialog to close. The dialog remained visible after these actions, so the outcome was not caused by an agent click, direct navigation, or use of a substitute control. The later expectation of a visible “Menu” control is also inconsistent with this desktop layout, which shows a direct “Construction Monitoring” link, but the unclosable privacy dialog independently blocked progress.
